title: Transpose Matrix
summary: Flip a rectangular grid over its main diagonal so that rows become columns.

tests.explain: A square grid is mirrored over its main diagonal: the first row becomes the first column.
A 2 x 3 grid becomes a 3 x 2 grid. The result has a different shape from the input.
A single column turns into a single row.

hints: Take a small 2 x 3 grid and write down where each value goes. The value at row i, column j ends up at row j, column i.
The result has as many rows as the input has columns, and the other way round. A non-square grid cannot be transposed in place.
Create the result with the swapped shape (build each row separately so rows are not shared), then copy matrix[i][j] into result[j][i].

complexity.time: O(rows * columns): every cell is copied once
